title: Schooling and EdTech Timeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Explore twenty events in the history of schooling and educational technology from 1848 to 2022, then place eight of them in their eras.

educational.topic: History of schooling and educational technology
learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight events from the history of schooling and educational technology into one of five eras, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The industrial-era school model, Carnegie unit, education policy, charter school, virtual school, and the history of EdTech, from Chapter 3.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a timeline, then classify events into eras without dates
keyQuestions: When were the structures of the school day set?
When did each wave of educational technology arrive?
commonMisconceptions: Technology in schools is a recent phenomenon
Every wave of educational technology was adopted quickly and used as promised
School structures such as the Carnegie unit and age grading came from the computer age
assessmentOpportunities: In which era was the Carnegie unit defined?
Is technology in schools a recent idea?
Did age grading come from the computer age?

controls.name: Timeline events
